name: Riibase CRM
summary: CRM for small teams with customizable sales pipelines, follow-up automation and AI credits, priced per team rather than per seat, with CSV and Excel import.
best_for: small teams in e-commerce, insurance or services that want a simple CRM with pipelines and follow-up automation for one flat team price instead of per-seat billing
skip_if: you have more than 5,000 records but do not want to pay for Enterprise, or you need to know today what you will pay after December 2026
honest_knock: Subscription fees are non-refundable unless stated otherwise, so the 10-day trial is your only safe test. Records are tight on the cheaper plans: 500 on Starter and 5,000 on Pro, so a contact list of a few thousand pushes you up a tier. The current prices are presented as a promotion ending in December 2026, and the page does not say what they become afterwards.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · flat monthly price for up to 5 users, 500 records and 5,000 AI credits
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-23 on riibase.com/pricing; dollar amounts, the page does not name the currency) Riibase prices its CRM per team, not per seat. Starter is $9.90 a month for up to 5 users, 500 records and 5,000 AI credits; Pro is $19.90 a month for up to 15 users, 5,000 records and 15,000 AI credits; Enterprise is $59.90 a month for up to 30 users, unlimited records and 25,000 AI credits. A banner calls these prices a price drop with the promotion ending in December 2026, and a second banner offers 25% off all plans with the code WELCOME25 before 31 December 2026; the page does not say whether the two combine or what the prices become afterwards. There is a 10-day free trial without a credit card. No annual price is shown, and no price for extra AI credits.

exit_test.what: Two contacts and custom text fields were imported. Export showed Completed but its download returned 404 twice, leaving no file. A separate email-key reimport updated the second contact without duplicates.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 2 November 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We imported two made-up contacts with custom fields, tried to export them, and re-imported an edited file to update one contact. We did not open the checkout.
findings: The banner read '10 days left in your free trial (ends Nov 12, 2026)', matching the pricing page, and the toolbar showed 500 AI credits.
The trial allows 50 records, and two demo contacts already counted towards that. The dashboard said Total Contacts 0 while the contact list showed the two demos.
Import let us match on email and create our extra columns as new text fields on the spot. Tags arrived as a single text field.
The export task said Completed, but its Download link returned '404 Page Not Found' twice, so we never got the file.
Re-importing an edited file with On Duplicate set to Update changed the second contact after about 45 seconds and created no duplicates.
not_tested: Checkout, tax and the paid plans
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
